newsitem.title: USA: A resurgent Japan surplus may risk friction--Rubin.
newsitem.headline: A resurgent Japan surplus may risk friction--Rubin.

text.p: Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin warned Japan on Wednesday that a renewed rise in its trade surplus could lead to friction with the United States and other economic partners.
"If you had a resurgence of a trade surplus ... it has the potential of doing that," he said of the possibility of friction.

Rubin noted that there were "all kinds of frictions" three or four years ago when Japan's surplus was high. Since that time, its current account surplus has fallen from about 3.1 percent of gross domestic product to 1.4 percent, he said. Rubin was speaking to the New York Stock Exchange Board of Directors here.
